gap: A partial evidence reading of a windowed CSV or workbook is read again when its table's raw streaming job finishes

built.queueIntakeEvidenceTx: optional rawJobId; with one the stable job id ends ':raw:<rawJobId>', without one it is the earlier id exactly (tested)
built.queueFinishedTableEvidenceTx: intake-evidence.ts: reads the raw job's state and source; when completed or completed_with_rejections it locks the readings' job rows FOR SHARE, then queues one reading for each table coverage row of that source that is partial or reading under a running job
built.call: streaming-vector-worker.ts runStreamingVectorJob, in the beforeCommit of acceptUspJobAttempt right after usp_streaming_vector_imports.state is set to its finished status and before the case outbox append; guarded by isWindowedTable(input)

decisions.D1: one new reading per partial (or running) coverage row; the coverage row points at it through the existing upsert
decisions.D2: the partial reading's job, result and candidates are kept until the new reading writes; candidate ids are stable by evidence identity and literal (the raw job is not in them), so every earlier candidate reappears once under the same id. Officer decisions live in usp_intake_evidence_confirmations pins, which nothing here touches; the candidate's candidateSha256 changes because its sourceCoverage changes from partial to closed
decisions.D3: a failed, stale or still running raw job queues nothing; a replay finds the new job already queued (or the coverage closed) and inserts nothing
